summary: `scripts/impact_closure.py` computes a change's impact closure over every relation form the vault keeps, read in tiers (generated relation views, typed front matter, relation blocks and body wikilinks, maps and navigation, then a targeted identifier search for gaps), with the tier recorded per edge. It proves unchanged approved notes by each owning compiler's approval hash, widens on a shared contract or the process policy, reports graph gaps and tier disagreements, and heals a missing relation through the vault relation contract, re-rendering the generated views; read-only roles are refused (#441). `scripts/vault_query.py` answers closure, related, who-cites, path, find, hash, changed-since, gaps and text search from a disposable JSON index under the project runtime scratch, rebuilt incrementally by file hash. Nothing calls either tool until a process switch selects it.
